cad.title: pcb-enclosure
cad.subtitle: custom-fit enclosure for pcb assembly
cad.description: I was tasked with designing a custom PCB enclosure. The design was simple, cost-effective, and easy to print
cad.problem: I struggled with optimising weight to ensure an efficient product was designed
cad.solution: I chose to proceed with lighter plastic PVC given its poor electrical conductivity to prevent short-circuit of electrical components

cad.title: Helical Gear
cad.subtitle: Helical gear model
cad.description: I was tasked with designing a helical gear. The aim of this project was to demonstrate my skills in chamfering, cut-extrude operations, and my understanding of gear mechanics.
cad.problem: Determining the appropriate gear ratio relative to the gear size was challenging. A higher tooth-to-size ratio resulted in distorted or damaged gear geometry.
cad.solution: I experimented with reducing the number of teeth until the gear geometry was properly formed while maintaining the desired design characteristics.
